title: SOS rate-limit tuple lacks SOS-ID/seq dimension; rotation silently resets buckets
description: Edge-pass notes from project-LICHEN-worker6-lzgc review (both pre-existing, unacknowledged). (1) spec/12-apps.md §18.4.1 tracks (origin address, count, uptime) only — 'Burst allowance 2: allows rapid updates to same SOS' is not implementable as stated because the tuple has no SOS-ID/seq dimension (§18.4.2 seq field exists in the payload but is not tracked); updates and distinct SOSes are indistinguishable to the limiter. Either track (origin, SOS-ID) or reword the rationale. (2) Key rotation (06-security.md §8.7.4 derives and pins a new identity) silently resets the 3/hour bucket and soft-blacklist score — an abuser rotates to evade; acknowledge in §18.4.1 or §8.7.4 (e.g., rotation attestation carries over abuse state, or accept and document the evasion window).
